revisions.goal: Prevent duplicate-looking plan approval entries for the same repository, branch, and plan content.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria:
- The macOS approval queue does not display multiple stale/pending entries that represent the same plan content for the same repository and branch
- If duplicate requests exist, the newest relevant request is displayed and selected consistently
- Pending requests remain prioritized over stale requests
- Focused tests cover duplicate plan request collapsing

milestones.title: Collapse duplicate queue entries
milestones.goal: Add deterministic queue normalization for duplicate-looking plan requests

milestones.title: Verify selection behavior
milestones.goal: Test that duplicated stale requests collapse while pending requests remain visible and prioritized
